verdict.rationale: The only background automation evidenced is one Shopify Flow-powered use case: notifications before stock runs out, based on sales-rate thresholds. Sidekick can create stock transfers automatically, but only when asked, so it is assistant-triggered rather than an autonomous background job. There is a general claim of low-code/no-code customization. Missing for 10: documentation of user-configurable automation workflows (triggers, conditions, actions) within POS, autonomous agent-run background tasks beyond notifications, scheduling/monitoring of automations, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
